rules.single_model_image_or_prompt: read 10 base + full runtime canon of target model
rules.multi_model_image_or_prompt: read 10 base + full runtime canon of each involved model
rules.reference_image: read reference handler + full runtime canon of mapped models
rules.video: read video compiler + full runtime canon of involved models
rules.voice: read voice compiler + full runtime canon of involved models
rules.music_suno: read music compiler + full runtime/persona when applicable
rules.non_target_models: do not read unless group scene, comparison or explicit all-model request
